Eli Lilly (NYSE:LLY) plans to invest over US$3.5b in a new Pennsylvania manufacturing facility focused on next generation injectable weight loss therapies. The company announced new collaborations with Repertoire Immune Medicines for autoimmune disease programs and Seamless Therapeutics for gene editing treatments aimed at hearing loss.
